name: Extremis-level Threat
summary: Once per battle in your Command phase: until your next Command phase, models with Oath of Moment also re-roll the Wound roll (not just the Hit roll) against your Oath of Moment target.

name: Shield of the Imperium
summary: Adeptus Astartes ranged weapons gain the Heavy ability; those that already had Heavy add 1 to the Wound roll when the firing unit Remained Stationary this turn.

name: Rapid Deployment
summary: An Adeptus Astartes unit disembarking from a non-Fly Transport that made a Normal or Advance move this phase, and did not arrive from Strategic Reserves, can make a D6" Normal move, or D3+3" from a 14+ Wound Heavy Transport.

name: Mastered Doctrines
summary: Up to 3 times per battle, pick an unused Combat Doctrine until your next Command phase: shoot after Advancing, shoot/charge after falling back, or charge after Advancing. Repeats need Marneus Calgar. Army: Ultramarines only.

name: Adaptive Defence
summary: Adeptus Astartes models in a terrain feature re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1. Units also gain Entrenched while in terrain, not set up that turn, and having moved 3" or less this turn.

name: Wrath of Dorn
summary: Attacks against your Oath of Moment target from models with Oath of Moment re-roll a Wound roll of 1; a Darnath Lysander unit's attacks against that target re-roll the Wound roll entirely. Army: Imperial Fists only.

name: Close-range Eradication
summary: Adeptus Astartes ranged weapons gain Assault, and get +1 Strength when their attack targets a unit within 12 inches.

name: Vulkan’s Quest
summary: Adeptus Astartes ranged weapons gain Assault and add 1 Strength against targets within 12". With Vulkan He'stan in your army, Infernus Squads may start an Action after Advancing or shoot after starting one. Salamanders only.

name: Skystrike
summary: Land Speeder and Storm Speeder Hailstrike/Hammerstrike/Thunderstrike units count as Speeder; in your first Movement phase, friendly Speeder units can make an ingress move.

name: Calculated Annihilation
summary: Attacks against your Oath of Moment target from models with the Oath of Moment ability re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

name: Recalculating
summary: Once per battle round, after your Oath of Moment target is destroyed, if a Caanok Var model is on the battlefield, one enemy unit visible to it becomes your Oath of Moment target until you pick a new one.

name: Target Sighted
summary: Tank Ace units - Adeptus Astartes Vehicles other than Fortifications, Drop Pods, Walkers and Fly - skip the Advance roll for a flat +6" Move, and re-roll Damage when shooting if they did not Advance. Up to three may gain Character.

name: Armoured Wrath
summary: Once per phase, each Adeptus Astartes unit in your army may re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit.

name: Psychic Disciplines
summary: Each battle round pick a Discipline for Adeptus Astartes Psykers until round end: Biomancy +2" M; Divination re-roll Hit/Wound 1s; Pyromancy ranged +1 AP within 12"; Telekinesis -1 S vs ranged; Telepathy ignores BS/WS/hit modifiers.

name: Rapid-drop Deployment
summary: At deployment, 2/3/4 non-Titanic Adeptus Astartes units by battle size gain Deep Strike. A model set up this turn re-rolls a Wound roll of 1; if it disembarked from a Drop Pod this turn it re-rolls a Hit roll of 1 as well.

name: Oath of Reclamation
summary: Adeptus Astartes melee attacks get +1 AP on units within range of an objective. Your unit within range of a marker you controlled at the phase start takes -1 to Wound from stronger attacks, or all attacks with Titus. Ultramarines only.

name: Masters of Shadow
summary: A ranged attack against an Adeptus Astartes unit from beyond 12 inches gives that unit Benefit of Cover.

name: Unparalleled Tactician
summary: Once per battle round, if Aethon Shaan is on the battlefield, you can use the Into Darkness Stratagem for 0 Command Points.

name: Storm-swift Onslaught
summary: Adeptus Astartes units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Wrath of the First Khan
summary: At the end of the Fight phase, if a Suboden Khan unit destroyed an enemy unit this phase and isn't engaged, it can make a Normal move of up to 6 inches.

name: Lightning Assault
summary: Adeptus Astartes units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Nowhere to Hide
summary: Friendly Phobos/Scout Squad units can mark a visible enemy unit within 12" as detected during your Shooting phase; a detected unit's detection range is increased by 3".

name: Shadow Masters
summary: A ranged attack against an Adeptus Astartes unit from beyond 12 inches gives that unit Benefit of Cover.

name: Imperator Unleashed
summary: After an Adeptus Astartes Fly Infantry unit makes an ingress or charge move this turn, its attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.
